aliases: Hong Kong Virtual Asset Exchange Limited
entity.summary: Hong Kong-based licensed centralized virtual asset trading platform operated by Hong Kong Virtual Asset Exchange Limited, serving professional and institutional users through virtual asset, security-token, over-the-counter, and related custody-oriented services.
entity.notes: The current first-party site presents active institutional and professional virtual asset trading services. Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission lists Hong Kong Virtual Asset Exchange Limited, trading as HKVAX, as a licensed virtual asset trading platform under CE reference BPW549, licensed on 2024-10-03. The regulatory listing is used as operator, identity, and current licensing evidence rather than as a performance endorsement. No exact launch date or lifecycle event is asserted.
